description:
In the permanent-sampling-feas grid, `host_submission_s` is an asynchronous dispatcher submission span on `gpu_hip` rows (backend.rs:613) but a host clock wrapped around the candidate's whole synchronous batch evaluation on registered-prototype rows (backend.rs:516-520). Read naively as launch overhead, a prototype row's value overstates the launch by three orders of magnitude.

## Background

Observed in campaign run 20260814T230032Z-2085453: prototype rows report host_submission_s at 0.75-1.00 of eval_s while gpu_hip rows report 0.0000-0.0019 of eval_s. The F_3 receipts (dev/studies/047b62ed/receipts.md section 4.3) document the dual semantics and use device-clock `device_submission_to_kernel_s` for cross-path launch comparisons. Surfaced by the F_3 receipt campaign (047b62ed) review.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Either the column carries one semantic across all device-path rows, or the schema splits the two measurements into distinctly named columns, with the CSV header/preamble documenting the meaning.
- [hard] REQ-02: A test or emitted preamble assertion prevents a synchronous whole-evaluation span from being emitted under a name that denotes submission overhead.

## Notes

Behavioral output change to the harness; same evidence/tool-revision coordination note as the CSV quoting fix. Fixing both in one schema revision is sensible.
title: Harness host_submission_s column carries two semantics across backend rows
